name: Riftglass Dragon - Venerable
description: Venerable Riftglass is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with fractured violet crystal plates reflecting unreal lives. It seeks to turn certainty into contradiction. At this age it is a legendary, nearly unstoppable presence.

attacks.name: Crystal Claws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (4)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 4 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: False Reflection
abilities.description: The first attack against the dragon each GM turn has disadvantage.

abilities.name: Refraction Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 22. On a failure, take 4d8+10 magic damage and the dragon moves the target to another visible place within Very Close range. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Contradictory Paths
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose up to two creatures within Close range. Each must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be moved to an unoccupied visible place within Close range and become Vulnerable until its next action.

abilities.name: One More Reflection
abilities.description: Once per scene, when an attack would make the dragon mark its last HP, mark 1 Stress instead, move it to an unoccupied visible place within Close range, and leave 1 HP unmarked.

abilities.name: Shatter Possibility
abilities.description: Spend a Fear. Choose up to three creatures within Far range. Each makes a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, it takes 4d8+10 magic damage and marks 2 Stress; on a success, it takes half damage without marking Stress.

abilities.name: Epic Ferocity
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks its fifth HP, it clears 2 Stress and may immediately move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack. If it has fewer than five HP, trigger this after it marks half its total HP instead.
